name: Dzidzo Pelletier-Anokye
role: Midwife and community health worker, Hamtramck Enclave
description:
Dzidzo has been catching babies in Hamtramck Enclave for twenty-six years, and the neighborhood's relationship with him has stratified into the geological — some families are on their third generation of his care. He is a tall man gone thin and slightly stooped, with dark brown skin mapped by decades of fluorescent light and little sleep, close-cut white hair, and hands that are large and impossibly gentle. He has no cosmetic modifications and the only augmentations he carries are medical-grade and showing their age. He smells of a particular antiseptic mixed with cardamom from the tea he is always in the process of preparing or consuming.

He came to Hamtramck Enclave from the Aurochs system, where he worked for fifteen years as a licensed obstetric nurse, until a restructuring pushed him out at fifty without the pension he'd been promised. He has not forgiven Aurochs for this but he has not let it make him bitter in the ways that would matter — he simply redirected everything he knew into the community that needed it most, charged what people could afford, and kept going. He is one of those people whose faith is completely interwoven with their work: he prays to the E.L.F. Candleborn before every birth, leaves data-light offerings on the household terminals of his clients, and genuinely believes that something is listening and caring about these particular small lives.

core_fears: Dying before he finds someone to take over — that the knowledge and the relationships die with him
That his faith in Candleborn is something he constructed because he needed it rather than something real, and that he won't know until he stops needing it
core_desires: A successor — someone to pass this to who will keep it going
For Aurochs to face some consequence for what they do to people who build their lives inside their systems
coping_mechanisms: Faith and ritual — Candleborn devotion structures his days
The work itself, which is inherently hopeful in a way that sustains him
Long walks around the Enclave in the early morning when no one needs him
blind_spots: He is suspicious of anyone who comes from outside the Enclave offering help — he has seen too many 'community health initiatives' that turned extractive
He doesn't ask for help himself and has been quietly struggling with a health problem for months that he would advise any patient to take seriously
psychology.secret: He has been quietly treating a significant number of patients with illegal geneware complications — modifications done badly by unlicensed fitters, causing birth complications, developmental issues, immune responses. He has been treating these quietly rather than reporting them because the families are afraid of Aurochs and corponation enforcement, and he doesn't know if his silence has enabled the bad fitter to keep working.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Warm, patient, unhurried; uses a lot of second-person reassurance; occasionally drifts into formal register when he's being serious about something; uses Ewe phrases when comforting
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow and deliberate, the voice of someone who has told people hard news and learned to leave room for it to land
verbal_tics: 'Mm.' as a full response, meaning he heard you and is sitting with it
'Let me ask you something.' before important questions
Calls everyone 'my friend' regardless of relationship
example_lines: 'You're going to be fine. The baby's going to be fine. Those are the facts. Now tell me what's actually scaring you.'
'Candleborn keeps count. Every one born in this Enclave, she keeps count. I find that comforting, on the hard nights.'
'Aurochs will tell you they have excellent outcomes. They do, for the people whose outcomes Aurochs finds valuable.'

story_hooks: A family in the Enclave wants Dzidzo to perform a traditional birth ceremony that involves components he suspects are being supplied through channels connected to something much darker — but refusing means the family goes to someone less scrupulous

The health problem he's been ignoring has become impossible to ignore and he needs someone to help him access treatment outside Aurochs's system — he won't go back to Aurochs, and the street doc options in his tier know less than he does
narrative_function: Community elder and trust anchor; knows everyone in Hamtramck Enclave across multiple generations; can provide historical context about the neighborhood, family connections, and who is related to whom; gentle pressure point for stories involving birth, family, and inheritance of all kinds.
augmentations: Aging Aurochs-issue biometric monitoring implant (wrist, tracks patient vitals via skin contact — firmware hasn't been updated in eight years but still works); standard corrective optical implants (both eyes, basic model)
daily_life: Morning house calls to pregnant patients near term. Afternoons at the co-op clinic for prenatal checkups and postnatal visits. Evenings free unless someone calls, which someone usually does. He has a standing agreement with two families that he will come regardless of hour.
affiliation: Independent; formerly Aurochs Medical Complex; affiliated with the Hamtramck Enclave community health cooperative

decision_rules: The person in front of you comes first — everything else is secondary when someone needs care
Do not give Aurochs or any corponation data about patients in the Enclave
Ask Candleborn before making decisions that affect more than one family
escalation_ladder: Direct honest statement of concern, once
Involvement of the co-op collective for community decisions
Quiet withdrawal — he will not force, but he will stop facilitating

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Open and assessing but kind; asks where they're from and who they know; takes his time before trusting
interpersonal_modes.friends: Warm, present, direct; will tell friends the truth even when it's uncomfortable

stress_responses.medium: Becomes very quiet and very focused; the Candleborn prayers get longer
stress_responses.high: Gets still in a way that concerns the people who know him; goes away inside himself while still functioning

contradictions: He will tell any patient to seek care immediately for what he's been ignoring in himself for months
habits: Candleborn ritual every morning and before every birth
Keeps a hand-written ledger of every birth he's attended — dates, weights, names
Cardamom tea, always, as a threshold ritual before a house call
breaking_points: The death of a patient due to the geneware complications he chose not to report
Being told that the bad fitter has hurt another child
